name: The Antlered Shade
place: is seen between the oldest trees of Wychwood on misty mornings, never twice in the same glade
_doc: Stream E (M2). A stag made of shadow and moss. It charges through the trees (long line), its bellow fears anyone in front, and at half health it splits the herd: two lesser stags and safe circles of sunlight in the dark wood.

party.solo: Hard solo: the extra stags are tough at level 6.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: The mist parts. A stag is watching you. Its eyes are holes.
Every bird in Wychwood goes quiet at once.
say.death: The Antlered Shade dissolves into mist and moss.
say.reset: The Shade steps back between the trees and is gone.

charge.name: Through the Trees
charge.say: The Shade lowers its antlers at {target}!

bellow.name: Hollow Bellow
bellow.say: The Shade throws back its head — do not stand in front of it!

sunlight.name: Shafts of Sun
sunlight.say: The wood goes dark — stand in the shafts of sunlight!

phases.name: The Herd
phases.say: Two more shapes step out of the mist.
